profile.name: 数字万用表校准系统
profile.description: 用于数字万用表校准与核查的实验室测试系统，通常由待校万用表、已校准的参考万用表以及电源或激励源组成，用于施加已知电信号并比较测量结果，从而完成校准和精度检查。
profile.description_en: A laboratory test system for calibrating and verifying digital multimeters. It typically consists of the multimeter under test, a calibrated reference multimeter, and a power supply or stimulus source used to apply known electrical signals and compare readings for calibration and accuracy checks.

registry.name: Multimeter Calibration App
registry.description: 万用表校准应用程序，提供自动化校准流程和校准数据记录功能。
